land_pattern.package: 6070 bracket 2-lead (one pad per side, diagonally offset)
land_pattern.notes: From the Recommended Soldering Pattern, datasheet p8. PRINTED dimensions: pad 2.5 mm wide x 1.8 mm high; 1.15 mm offset of each pad centre from the package centreline; overall span across the outer pad edges 14.5 mm; central circular thermal land dia 6.0 mm. The two pads are NOT collinear - they are diagonally staggered, each offset 1.15 mm to the opposite side of the centreline, i.e. 2.30 mm centre-to-centre vertical stagger (verified by measuring both pads on the drawing: 2.30 mm). This matches the p8 top view where lead 1 exits low-left and lead 2 exits high-right. row_spacing_mm 12.0 = pad centre to pad centre horizontally (14.5 minus one pad width; scales to 12.04 mm). No pitch_mm is meaningful for a 2-pad staggered layout. The p8 top view also dimensions the metal base/slug width as 7.3 mm. Package tolerance +/-0.25 mm unless noted.
